voice_names.phone: Ava - Female Robot or AI Assistant

lines: [calm, robotic] Tomorrow. Nine fourteen A.M. The man in the grey coat drops his coffee.
[panicking, excited] Bro, you put everything on one number?!
[screaming with joy] Two million dollars! How?!
[calm, robotic] Tomorrow. Twelve P.M. The bridge collapses. Fourteen cars on it.
[angry shouting] Get out of the road, man!
[desperate, shouting] Turn around! The bridge is going down!
[muffled, friendly but strange] Alex? It's me. Open the door.
[soft, eerie] Would you look? Follow for more what-ifs.
